groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.outcome: Keep current action/failure focus and inputs;block repeated submits;later navigation wins.
groups.judgment: Connect and Save retain stable focusable actions with aria busy/unavailable;entry/submission refs guard before pending renders. Library selection state lives above the page,while failed sign-in fields stay local. Current account-switch check confirms failed server discovery keeps attempted fields and Connect focus.
remaining: Dated native controls use held/injected faults and exact phases. No fresh successful-auth/forced-window matrix,VoiceOver or listener result.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: Successful sign-in or initial library save completes
groups.outcome: Hand off only the accepted current action to its next visible heading;cancel for later user intent.
groups.judgment: Transition stores the returned destination and compares current account/exact libraries before selecting a visible heading. RetryFocus captures scope and current action before work and revokes ownership on later intent. The handoff follows accepted connection update,not later library/audio load completion.
remaining: Authentication record excludes new cold expired replay,explicit discovery-query failure and forced pointer/overlay/window/stale-no-op matrix. Those source guards are not a full runtime proof.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: Use another account/server during initial selection
groups.outcome: Retain old account and choices until accepted authentication;successful login resets choices and refreshes access.
mandatoryVariants: Back versus failed versus successful sign-in
Different account/server replaces only after commit
Repeated entry current-server prefill dependency AS01
groups.judgment: Chooser remains mounted while the sign-in form opens. Login resets the checkbox draft only after accepted authentication. Failed authentication leaves the committed service account and checkbox state;Back restores the account-switch action. Current prefill contradiction is fixed and retained separately as AS01.
remaining: Current AS01 native run tests failed public-info discovery,not rejected password or successful account replacement. Earlier controlled authentication records retain their own source/runtime limits.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.outcome: Count/submit only accessible choices;empty recovery retains retry intent without selecting for the listener.

Returned first checkbox focused but unchecked
groups.judgment: Chooser filters submitted/count IDs through current access and blocks empty/unknown reads. Retry has native focus retention with an async guard;successful owned recovery targets the first available checkbox without changing selection. Same component is used initially and in General. Real restricted-account access was granted and recovered through explicit native Retry in the dated live record.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection

groups.outcome: Keep exact submitted choices/pending/error for the current session;serialize account actions and preserve expiry.
mandatoryVariants: Settings chooser remains mounted after success
Focused clean saved control until blur
Expiry waits for save and remains visible
Late old callback cannot reopen session
groups.judgment: App-owned provider stores choices and mutation lifetime. Submission captures account/revision/done and applies only to active unchanged ownership. Settings chooser is keyed by account,not library list. UI blocks overlaps and expiry completion does not clear the expired screen;current auth-revision handling remains AUTH01.
remaining: Controlled navigation/storage faults are not every live permission/OS failure. Auth focus and stale/no-op variants retain the handoff record limits;no whole M11 acceptance inferred.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: Restore or replace a connection on one or two installations
groups.outcome: Protect session locally;use independent persistent device identity with honest session-only fallback.
mandatoryVariants: No restorable replacement when identity/storage unavailable
Preserve old readable account until safe replacement
groups.judgment: Device identity uses race-safe private-file publication and process fallback. The same identity feeds API and media authorization. Credentials use safeStorage;new session-only acceptance clears an old encrypted record through the commit boundary. An older readable account is not discarded merely for temporary identity fallback. Settings discloses restore limitations.
remaining: One live server/account and macOS architecture;filesystem/encryption unavailable branches are controlled. Converted HEAD establishes route/identity only. Other installs/OS combinations and subjective use remain separate.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: Multiple sign-ins or sign-out overlap before publication
groups.outcome: A newer intent supersedes older requests;failure retains the committed account without reviving stale attempts.
mandatoryVariants: Failed newer login retains committed account
Failed signout keeps original committed account
groups.judgment: Connect advances intent before network requests and checks it after each boundary. Sign-out advances it immediately before asynchronous preparation pause. Candidate failures do not replace the committed account;superseded attempts stay invalid even when sign-out fails.
remaining: Explicit controlled checkpoints prove enumerated races,not a naturally induced real-server token invalidation history. Full physical storage,OS and native auth matrix remains broader.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: A credential publication or session-only clear is delayed/fails
groups.outcome: Commit exact account/library state in order;cancel unpublished replacements and never restore an older restorable account.
mandatoryVariants: Exact accepted account and library snapshot
Failed save retains latest committed state
Newer sign-in not canceled by older failure
groups.judgment: Service queues persistence and checks intent/revision before the synchronous publish callback. Storage stages protected bytes then publishes and promotes in the same turn. Failed uncommitted write leaves the latest committed state;postcommit cleanup failure does not roll it back. Session-only acceptance removes an old restorable credential before promotion.
remaining: Controlled real safeStorage/filesystem checkpoints are not every filesystem/Keychain state. Server-side invalidation of an older token remains a separate reconnect possibility even when local ownership is correct.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: Offline retry or account recovery occurs during radio editing/preparation
groups.outcome: Preserve current-session work for same-account recovery;clear transient work for another account/signout;retain saved local radio data.
groups.judgment: Radio drafts live in SessionContent keyed by account identity,above ReadyApp/expired views. Same-account reauthentication retains that owner while player remount restores paused. Different identity or confirmed signout remounts it. Durable local radio library is separate from transient draft/feedback. Live recovery record only induces read socket failure and genuine per-request401.
remaining: No fresh live reauthentication/draft preservation;controlled recovery supplies those branches. Live per-request bad token is not saved credential revocation or server shutdown. Full cross-lifetime invariant remains broader.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: Refresh or concurrently browse the collection
groups.outcome: Read current catalog/artwork and invalidate related cached views while retaining filters,selection,queue and owned Refresh focus.
mandatoryVariants: Busy/failure/success stable Refresh and duplicate guard
groups.judgment: Catalog ownership follows immutable session,not another view/cache eviction. Refresh invalidates songs,filters,details,albums and playlists without replacing view/selection/player state. Stable action uses synchronous/pending guards and no completion refocus. Current metadata retains revision tags through the media proxy. JR01 separately supplies obsolete committed-session completion checks.
remaining: Refresh navigation smoke is not a new changed-server-data/permission pass. Live metadata is sampled;multi-root overlap is controlled. No new complete display/AT or naturally concurrent server mutation proof.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: Open an album or inspect long collection metadata
groups.outcome: Read album identity metadata separately from tracks;keep playable tracks/actions and reveal full long titles/details.
mandatoryVariants: Metadata by album ID even if empty
Long collection title clamps without losing actions
groups.judgment: Album metadata and ordered tracks use independent query keys/errors. Fallback heading remains usable if metadata fails;actions depend on available tracks. CollectionHeading measures clipping and offers native disclosure;Inspector has independently refreshed complete metadata within its scrolling drawer.
remaining: Six-track live album and controlled missing metadata/long text are scoped examples,not every personal file or layout. No new visual run,VoiceOver or unassisted title-discovery proof.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: Read or mutate an account-accessible playlist
groups.outcome: Keep account authorization and honest permission/unknown states on every operation.
groups.judgment: Requests carry the current account token;optional permission lookup gives explicit true/false/null with401 preserved. UI blocks known false and pending permission reads;unknown allows the server to authorize. Serial/preflight/dispatch ownership prevents stale writes. PL groups retain compound playlist mutation recovery.
remaining: P05 still lacks a real unavailable-permission server configuration;controlled503 does not close it. No complete Jellyfin permission/version matrix or live stale-preflight test.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.trigger: JSON read/authentication stalls or a mutation confirmation is lost
groups.outcome: Bound full JSON response reads and classify failures without replaying uncertain writes;status-only success ignores unused bodies.
mandatoryVariants: Confirmed status-only writes despite stalled unused body
groups.judgment: Request timer spans fetch plus JSON consumption. Known HTTP failures retain service codes;network/parse uncertainty on writes stays uncertain-write. Status-only mutation response cancels unused body without waiting. Music protocol/player use separate stream recovery and never inherit JSON body semantics.
remaining: Deadline record is controlled local HTTP,not physical device/server outages. Current JR01 mutation cases preserve confirmation semantics but do not rerun all20-second timeout variants or live conversion/audio behavior.

groups.actor: Listener connecting or recovering a Jellyfin collection
groups.outcome: Keep credentials/tokens in protected storage and intended request headers,without logging them.
mandatoryVariants: Credentials not in renderer media URLs
groups.judgment: Current source exposes public connection metadata without token,password or device credential. API/media use intended authorization headers;renderer receives opaque app media URLs. IPC returns known service messages or generic failures;source log scan finds only a constant news-workflow message. Protected storage remains encrypted/private.
remaining: Current static boundary audit and controlled private-file checks are not a forensic audit of all historical console/network traces,OS crash logs or every external dependency. Other platform/Keychain states remain separate.
